q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution
The earnings release is scheduled for Wednesday, August 26, 2026 (in 2 days from today, August 24, 2026). This is an extremely short timeframe for a forward guidance forecast.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The question asks for NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue at the upcoming earnings release on August 26. 

**Key fact from research:** NVIDIA already provided forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 in its Q1 FY2027 earnings report on May 20, 2026: **$91.0 billion ± 2%** (range: $89.2B - $92.8B).

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will either:
1. **Maintain or slightly adjust this guidance** based on any updates since May 20
2. **Reaffirm the $91.0B guidance** if business conditions haven't materially changed

Given that we are now only 2 days before the earnings release, any new guidance would represent a relatively modest adjustment to the May guidance. Companies typically don't make drastic changes to quarterly guidance between quarters unless material business conditions have shifted dramatically.

Wall Street consensus is $91.9B (slightly above midpoint), with Jefferies at $95B being an outlier on the optimistic side.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Weaker-than-expected demand signals in the intervening period (since May 20)
- Supply chain disruptions
- Geopolitical concerns affecting China datacenter restrictions (already assumed in guidance)
- Macro weakness affecting customer capex plans
- Competitive pressures emerging

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Stronger demand for AI/datacenter products than expected
- Better-than-expected utilization/pricing
- Analyst consensus ($91.9B-$95B) suggesting market expects an increase
- Jefferies' $95B forecast reflecting potential upside momentum
- Supply constraints supporting pricing power

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the provided research, NVIDIA's May 20, 2026 guidance for Q2 FY2027 was **$91.0 billion ± 2%**, establishing a direct precedent. The current Wall Street consensus average is near $91.9 billion. Jefferies projects $95 billion on the optimistic end.

---

## Probability distribution reasoning

The guidance provided in May was $91.0B ± 2%, establishing a $89.2B-$92.8B range that was the company's own estimate three months ago. The Wall Street consensus has drifted modestly higher to $91.9B, and one prominent analyst (Jefferies) is at $95B.

Given:
- The company's own recent guidance at $91.0B
- Wall Street consensus at $91.9B (a ~0.9% increase)
- Jefferies at $95B as an optimistic outlier
- Only 2 days until resolution (minimal time for material changes)
- The guidance likely reflects known conditions as of late August

I expect the guidance to cluster around $91-93B, with some possibility of reaching toward $95B if there's been material upside surprise, but lower probability of breaching $100B+ or dropping below $89B.

Low (10th percentile): 89500000000
Median (50th percentile): 92000000000
High (90th percentile): 95000000000
q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is scheduled to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings report on Wednesday, August 26, after market close [morningstar.com](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/going-into-earnings-is-nvidia-stock-buy-sell-or-fairly-valued-8).

In its Q1 FY2027 earnings report on May 20, 2026, NVIDIA provided forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This range implies a ceiling near $92.8 billion and a floor near $89.2 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). The guidance assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm).

Wall Street analysts, according to Yahoo! Finance, have an average estimate near $91.9 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). Jefferies, on August 21, 2026, projected an even higher Q2 FY2027 revenue of $95 billion, and a Q3 FY2027 revenue forecast of $108 billion [finance.yahoo.com](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/1-veteran-analyst-sees-nvidia-115749161.html).
